papers.title: Thin-film lithium niobate waveguide-integrated p-i-n Tungsten selenide photodiodes with 10Gbit/s data reception
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) is a promising photonic platform in next-generation integrated optoelectronics and on-chip/chip-chip interconnection due to its attractive optical property and versatility. However, integration of conventional-material-based photodetectors on TFLN platforms still faces multiple challenges. Herein, a high-bandwidth TFLN-based waveguide-integrated lateral WSe 2 p-i-n photodetector is presented. The localized self-aligned doping process eliminates slow carrier diffusion and defect trapping in doped regions which further boosts modulation bandwidth. Secondly, n-type and p-type Ohmic contacts, along with a high-quality p-n junction, are achieved through Se vacancy defect engineering and high-work function molybdenum oxide buffer layer, respectively. Furthermore, combined with the high dielectric constant of lithium niobate suppressing ionized impurity scattering, carrier mobilities exceeding 350 cm 2 /V·s are achieved for both electrons and holes, significantly accelerating carrier drift. The device features a measured bandwidth of 1.12 GHz and a data rate up to 10 Gbit/s in visible light. Separately, the device achieves a responsivity of ~492 mA·W −1 and a near-unity external quantum efficiency of 95.6% at 638 nm. This combination of two-dimensional homostructure and TFLN nano-waveguides provides a basis for high-speed photodetectors and visible-light interconnections in future TFLN integrated optoelectronics and optical input/output applications.
papers.summary_ko: 박막 리튬나이오베이트(TFLN) 플랫폼에 텅스텐셀레나이드(WSe2) p-i-n 광검출기를 집적하여 10Gbit/s급 데이터 수신이 가능한 광소자를 구현한 연구이다. 자기정렬 도핑과 Se 공공 결함 제어를 통해 고품질 p-n 접합과 우수한 캐리어 이동도를 달성하였으며, 638nm에서 95.6%의 양자효율을 보였다. 배터리 소재와는 무관한 광전자 소자 분야의 연구이다.

papers.title: Regulation of Anionic Redox Reaction Voltage by Energy Band Modulation for Li-Rich Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Anionic redox reaction (ARR) promises high energy density for Li-rich cathodes yet suffers from severe voltage decay. Here, we investigate ARR voltage modulation in a Li2S-modified quasi-solid Li-rich cathode (Li2S-LRM), which exhibits a distinct low-voltage ARR plateau (2.0–2.8 V). Combining in situ XRD, S K-edge XANES, EELS, Ar-etched XPS and DFT calculations, we validate in situ electrochemical sulfur doping. Upon cycling, the material forms bulk LixS/Li–S–O species alongside a dominant Li2SO3/Li2SO4 polyanion interphase that realizes oxygen trapping. Vacancy-cluster formation facilitates reversible S-involved charge compensation, where sulfur redox activity progressively intensifies during long cycling. Enabled by the band-modulation and oxygen-trapping effects, Li2S-LRM achieves a high average Coulombic efficiency of 99.6% and suppressed voltage decay (0.28 vs. 0.83 mV cycle–1 for pristine LRM). This work deepens mechanistic insights into ARR and provides rational design guidance for high-performance anionic-redox cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: Li2S를 도입한 준고체 Li-rich 양극(Li2S-LRM)에서 음이온 레독스 반응(ARR) 전압을 조절한 연구이다. 사이클 중 Li2SO3/Li2SO4 계면이 형성되어 산소 트래핑을 유도하였으며, 이를 통해 평균 쿨롱 효율 99.6%와 전압 감쇄 억제(0.28 대 0.83 mV/cycle)를 달성하였다. 밴드 조절과 산소 트래핑 효과를 통해 고성능 음이온 레독스 양극 설계를 위한 메커니즘적 통찰을 제공한다.

papers.title: Hybrid Weakly Coordinated Solvents for Fast-Charging and Wide-Temperature Sodium-Ion Full Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract The application of sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) in wide-temperature and fast-charging scenarios is severely constrained by the performance limitations of electrolytes. Conventional ester-based electrolytes struggle to simultaneously achieve high ionic conductivity, low desolvation energy, and excellent interfacial stability. Herein, we propose a hybrid solvent system comprising ethyl propionate and ethoxy(pentafluoro)cyclotriphosphazene (PFPN), aiming to synergistically enhance the rate capability and temperature adaptability of SIBs. The relatively weak coordination ability of both solvents effectively promotes anion participation in solvation structure, significantly lowering the Na+ desolvation energy barrier and inducing the formation of stable, inorganic-rich electrode/electrolyte interphases. Meanwhile, the dual-solvent combination increases the diversity of solvation configurations and reduces ion clustering, thereby enhancing ionic conductivity. The intrinsic nonflammability and excellent film-forming ability of PFPN further enhance safety and synergistically strengthen interfacial stability. Therefore, Prussian blue||hard carbon full cells operate stably over a wide temperature range from −50 to 100 °C. Notably, ampere-hour-level pouch cells deliver a capacity retention of 86.3% after 300 cycles at 25 °C and maintain stable operation for over 100 cycles even at −20 and 80 °C. This solvent synergy strategy offers a practical new pathway for the development of electrolytes for SIBs in extreme environments.
papers.summary_ko: 에틸프로피오네이트와 PFPN을 결합한 약배위 하이브리드 용매 시스템을 제안하여 나트륨이온전지의 고속 충전 및 광범위 온도 성능을 향상시킨 연구이다. 약한 용매 배위력으로 음이온이 솔베이션에 참여하도록 유도해 탈솔베이션 에너지를 낮추고 무기물 위주의 안정적 계면을 형성시켰다. 프러시안블루||하드카본 파우치셀은 -50~100°C의 넓은 온도범위에서 작동하며 25°C 300사이클 후 86.3%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Engineering Ultrathin, Tough Polymer Networks for Stable Lithium Metal Anode Interphases
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Interfacial degradation and dendritic lithium (Li) growth remain critical bottlenecks for practical Li metal batteries (LMBs). Herein, we introduce a tough, ion-conductive poly(2-(dimethylamino)ethyl methacrylate) (pDMAEMA) nanolayer on Li metal via photo-initiated chemical vapor deposition (piCVD). The photo-mediated, solvent-free piCVD enables nanometer-scale coatings with systematic control over photo-crosslinking and chain entanglement without compromising Li surface integrity. This systematic control yields an optimized polymer network balancing toughness (36.3 MJ m–3) and viscoelasticity (10.3% linear viscoelastic strain limit) to accommodate repeated Li volume changes. Furthermore, interactions between pDMAEMA and PF6– anions promote a mechanically durable LiF-rich solid electrolyte interphase, thereby supporting uniform Li deposition. Pouch-type bi-cells employing the optimized 100 nm polymer-coated Li anode achieve an energy density of 338 Wh kg–1 and 80% capacity retention after 90 cycles under practical conditions (N/P = 2, E/C = 3 g Ah–1). This ultrathin, tough polymer network offers a promising design principle for high-energy LMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 광개시 화학기상증착(piCVD)을 이용해 리튬 금속 표면에 초박막의 질기고 이온전도성이 있는 pDMAEMA 고분자 나노층을 형성하여 리튬금속전지의 계면 안정성을 개선한 연구이다. 이 고분자망은 높은 인성(36.3 MJ/m³)과 점탄성을 가지며 PF6- 음이온과 상호작용해 LiF가 풍부한 기계적으로 견고한 SEI 형성을 유도한다. 100nm 코팅된 리튬 음극을 적용한 파우치형 바이셀은 338 Wh/kg의 에너지밀도와 90사이클 후 80%의 용량 유지율을 달성하였다.

papers.title: Anion Sublattice Engineering Induced Niobium-Tungsten Oxide with Near-Zero Residual Strain for Stable 100 C Cycling Capability
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Wadsley-Roth W3Nb14O44 is a fast-charging anode material but suffers from low electronic conductivity and electrochemical polarization. Here, anion-sublattice engineering is employed to regulate its electronic structure and Li+ storage kinetics. Density functional theory and kinetic analyses reveal that an appropriate concentration of oxygen vacancies enhances electronic conductivity, moderates Li+ adsorption, and facilitates Li+ diffusion, thereby reducing charge-transfer and diffusion impedances at low temperatures. In situ XRD and synchrotron radiation X-ray 3D nanocomputed tomography reveal reversible structural evolution with near-zero residual strain after cycling. Consequently, WNO-x delivers 77.4 mAh g–1 at 200 C and retains 72.6% capacity after 6000 cycles at 100 C while exhibiting low-temperature electrochemical activity. Moreover, the WNO-x||LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 full cell delivers 85.8 mAh g–1 at 20 C and retains 77.1% capacity after 3000 cycles, with cycling capability at –30 °C. Such structure-property insight provides a strategy for designing niobium-based oxide anodes toward fast-charging and low-temperature batteries.
papers.summary_ko: Wadsley-Roth 구조의 W3Nb14O44 음극 소재에 음이온(산소 공공) 서브격자 엔지니어링을 적용하여 전자전도성과 Li+ 확산 속도를 개선한 연구이다. 이를 통해 거의 0에 가까운 잔류 변형으로 100C에서 6000사이클 후 72.6%의 용량을 유지하였으며, 200C에서 77.4 mAh/g의 용량을 보였다. NCM 양극과의 풀셀에서도 20C에서 85.8 mAh/g 용량과 -30°C 저온 구동성을 확인하였다.
